verdict.rationale: Replit has a dedicated first-party docs page (add-custom-domain) that walks through moving a published app from its replit.app URL to a custom domain. Publishing gives the app its own production URL, which is what the custom domain gets attached to. missing for 10: details on DNS record setup, domain verification and SSL/TLS provisioning, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the flow works.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: Move Velocity from velocity.replit.app to velocityrentals.com.
Publishing creates a **production deployment**: a stable, shareable version of your app that runs at its own URL.
